facts.summary: Combination data showed high grade 3 toxicity and modest response rate · Phase 2 · adagrasib plus pembrolizumab in KRAS G12C NSCLC · not yet approved
facts.indication: first-line KRAS G12C-mutated advanced/metastatic non-small cell lung cancer

evidence.summary: Treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs) were Grade 1-2 (39%), Grade 3 (40%) and Grade 4 (4%); there were no Grade 5 TRAEs observed.
evidence.safety: Treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs) were Grade 1-2 (39%), Grade 3 (40%) and Grade 4 (4%); there were no Grade 5 TRAEs observed.
evidence.program_discontinued: Based on these data, we look forward to initiating a Phase 3 trial.
